# Pharma Source Direct

> NABP-accredited pharmaceutical distributor specializing in laboratory equipment, cleanroom supplies, and compounding pharmacy products with FDA/DEA compliance.

Pharma Source Direct is a wholesale supplier serving pharmacy compounding professionals with partnerships across major industry organizations. They distribute premium brands including OHAUS laboratory balances and Cleanroom Connection apparel, maintaining strict cGMP standards and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- NABP Accreditation
- FDA/DEA Compliance
- cGMP Standards
- Pharmacy Compounding
- OHAUS Distributor
- Laboratory Balances
- Cleanroom Supplies
- DuPont IsoClean
- Wholesale Supplier
- Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding
- Analytical Instruments
- Pharmaceutical Distribution
- Quality Assurance

## Product Categories

- [OHAUS – Balances & Laboratory Equipment](https://pharmasd.com/balances-lab-equipment-supplies): OHAUS balances and lab equipment distributor with wholesale pricing for analytical instruments and laboratory supplies
- [Cleanroom Connection – Cleanroom Supplies](https://pharmasd.com/cleanroom-connection): Cleanroom apparel and supplies distributor featuring DuPont and Lakeland products for pharmaceutical environments
